Jakarta Dengue Cases and Weather Data from 2021 to 2024.

dengue_jakarta.Rd

This data contains dengue cases hospitalized of Jakarta

Usage

dengue_jakarta

Format

A dataframe object with 2922 rows and 14 variables:

id

numeric id

reg

Region of Regency or City

date

Date of observation

tn

Minimum temperature in Celsius

tx

Maximum temperature in Celsius

tavg

mean temperature in Celsius

rh_avg

Average relative humidity in percent

rr

Rainfall in mm

ss

Sunshine duration in hours

ff_x

Maximum wind speed in meters by seconds)

ddd_x

Wind direction at maximum wind speed

ff_avg

Average wind speed in meters by second)

ddd_car

Most frequent wind direction

cases

Number of hospitalized patients

...

Source

https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/yutakatarokusumah/jakarta-dengue-weather-2021-2024, https://zenodo.org/records/21499199, https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets-py/, https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets-py/, https://pypi.org/project/denguedatasets/.

Details

The dengue_jakarta dataset has also been published in the denguedataset package in Python. jupyter notebook related https://www.kaggle.com/code/yutakatarokusumah/jakarta-dengue-risk-prediction
